verdict.rationale: AMD documents official Linux OS support and ROCm Linux driver/framework support (PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, ONNX, vLLM, llama.cpp) for the RX 9070 XT, showing Linux is a supported platform with real documentation depth. However, the evidence pack is entirely first-party (AMD/ROCm docs) with no independent Linux benchmarking, community driver-stability reports, or third-party hands-on testing to corroborate real-world Linux experience. Missing for 10: independent/third-party Linux testing or reviews, community-reported driver stability data, non-vendor corroboration of ROCm Linux performance.
